# TuzlaPark

Name: TuzlaPark

Type: Progressive Web Application

Description:
TuzlaPark is an AI-ready smart parking application for the City of Tuzla. It helps drivers locate parking zones, pay parking via SMS, navigate to available parking areas, manage parking sessions and use voice commands.

Core Features

- Smart Parking
- SMS Payment
- Parking Zones
- GPS Navigation
- Voice Assistant
- Offline Support
- Progressive Web App
- Leaflet Maps
- GeoJSON Parking Zones
- Geoapify Maps
- OpenStreetMap
- Multi-language
- Bosnian
- English
- German

Audience

Residents
Visitors
Tourists
Drivers

OpenStreetMap
